clue.text: See girl on coach but fail to take opportunity

parts.note: a young unmarried woman is addressed as Miss
being on a coach is being on the bus

explanation.surface: Someone spots a girl aboard a coach and lets a chance slip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is a link inviting the reader to picture the scene: a Miss on the bus.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: to be too late for the bus means letting a chance go by.

clue.text: Less familiar route followed by park official

parts.note: ST, short for street, stands for a route through town
a ranger looks after a national park

explanation.surface: An unfamiliar path, followed by a park warden.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative synonym: something less familiar is more unknown, odder.

clue.text: Jabber and annoy

definitions.meaning: a thing that jabs, as a sewing or injection point does

explanation.surface: Chattering on and irritating people.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp sewing spike is literally something that jabs; and the verb means provoke or irritate.

clue.text: A large number — doesn't matter which large number

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
any means whichever one you like

explanation.surface: A lot, and it makes no difference which lot.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: numerous, a lot of things.

clue.text: Makes whole — or gets near it, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the words given are only one possible arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Completing something, or coming close to doing so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' tells us to rearrange the letters of 'gets near it'.
explanation.definitionFit: To combine parts into a unified entity is to make it whole.

clue.text: First-class fare to Jupiter and Mars

definitions.text: First-class fare to Jupiter and Mars

parts.words: First-class fare to Jupiter and Mars
parts.note: reads like a premium ticket to planets, but fare is food and Jupiter and Mars are Roman gods

explanation.surface: The price of a luxury space trip to two planets.
explanation.walkthrough: Fare means food, not a ticket price, and Jupiter and Mars are gods, not planets: the food of the gods in classical myth.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek and Roman myth the immortals ate this divine food, so it is the finest fare.

clue.text: She has pain from one side to another

indicators.note: has means the outer letters hold the pain word between them

parts.note: R and L are right and left, the two sides
an ache is a pain

explanation.surface: A woman suffers a pain that spreads across her body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' is a girl's name; 'from one side to another' gives R (right) to L (left), which 'has' ACHE inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name, so a fair example of a female person.

clue.text: A great deal of money not yet used

definitions.meaning: making a fortune is making a packet, a lot of cash
in pristine condition, as a new stamp or coin

explanation.surface: A big sum of cash that nobody has spent.
explanation.definitionFit: Colloquially a fortune; also the collector's term for something in brand-new condition.

clue.text: Generally where the seas are high

definitions.meaning: on the whole, for the most part
the main is an old word for the open ocean, the high seas

explanation.surface: Usually found out on the high seas.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for mostly; and literally, out on the open ocean, the poetic main.

clue.text: Bohemian girl seen around a US resort

indicators.note: seen around means the girl's name surrounds the letter

parts.note: Mimi is the heroine of Puccini's opera La Boheme

explanation.surface: An arty young woman spotted at an American holiday town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bohemian' points to the opera La Boheme, whose heroine is Mimi.
explanation.definitionFit: A Florida city famous as a beach holiday destination.

clue.text: Be ready to give support

definitions.meaning: to be prepared and waiting to act
to stick with someone and back them up

explanation.surface: Prepare to help someone out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both wait in readiness and remain loyal to a person.

clue.text: Listeners burning to get within hearing distance

parts.note: ears are what we listen with
hot means burning

explanation.surface: Someone with burning ears creeps close enough to eavesdrop.
explanation.walkthrough: Burning ears are said to mean someone is talking about you, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The range within which a voice can be heard.

clue.text: A huge sprawling city

indicators.note: sprawling suggests letters spread about and rearranged

explanation.surface: A vast city spreading out in every direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sprawling' rearranges A and HUGE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dutch seat of government, home of the international courts.

clue.text: Case for building-up, ready for the maiden flight

definitions.text: Case for building-up, ready for the maiden flight

parts.words: Case for building-up, ready for the maiden flight
parts.note: sounds like an aircraft under construction, but the case is where a pupa develops before a butterfly first flies

explanation.surface: A shell for something under construction before its first test flight.
explanation.walkthrough: The aviation picture misleads: the case is the pupa's shell, and the maiden flight is the emerging butterfly's first.
explanation.definitionFit: The hard casing in which an insect grows into its winged adult form.

clue.text: She may be recalled in pantomime

definitions.text: She may be recalled in pantomime

indicators.note: may be says the letters could form another word, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actress remembered for a pantomime role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' rearranges RECALLED IN, and the whole clue describes the heroine of a British Christmas pantomime, a comic family stage show, who is literally called back from the ball at midnight.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairy-tale heroine is a staple of the festive stage show and is summoned home at midnight.

clue.text: One of the family takes the veil in religious order

parts.note: a sister is a family member
a hood is a head covering like a veil

explanation.surface: A family member becomes a nun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes the veil' means becoming a nun, which fits the definition, but here 'takes' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A community of nuns is a religious body of women.

clue.text: Roughly disturb canaries' nests that should be protected

indicators.note: roughly suggests the letters are handled carelessly and rearranged

explanation.surface: Do not disturb the canaries' nests: they need protecting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roughly' rearranges DISTURB CANARIES.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserves where wild birds and their nesting sites are kept safe from harm.

clue.text: Cutting off lady on telephone call

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the first piece above the second

parts.note: she refers to a lady
giving someone a ring is making a phone call

explanation.surface: A woman's phone call is cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: Clipping a sheep's fleece is cutting it off.

clue.text: Break popular with those on edge

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
the fringe are people at the margins of a group

explanation.surface: A popular breakthrough among nervous folk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on edge' suggests nervousness; the fringe are those at the edge.
explanation.definitionFit: To violate a rule or right, as in breaking a law or patent.

clue.text: Playing around with males, she's quite brazen

indicators.note: playing around with signals the letters are toyed with and rearranged

parts.note: the letters of she's without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A woman flirting with men is entirely unabashed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Playing around' fits the flirting surface, but with 'with' it tells us to rearrange the letters that follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Without any embarrassment or modesty, so wholly brazen.

clue.text: Publicity wrong for counsel

parts.note: an ad is a publicity notice
a vice is a wrong or sin

explanation.surface: An advertising lawyer gives poor legal help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'counsel' looks like a barrister, but it is the noun for guidance.
explanation.definitionFit: Guidance offered to someone is a synonym of counsel as a noun.

clue.text: Weapon in sack

definitions.meaning: to sack is to plunder or ransack

explanation.surface: A gun hidden in a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sack' looks like a bag but it is the verb to ransack.
explanation.definitionFit: A firearm; and the verb meaning to search through and steal from.

clue.text: It's to do with wrought-iron artist

parts.note: re means concerning, to do with

indicators.note: wrought means worked into shape, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Something connected with a craftsman of decorative ironwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrought' rearranges IRON into NOIR.
explanation.definitionFit: The French Impressionist painter is a famous artist.

clue.text: Terribly grieved, draw apart

indicators.note: terribly suggests the letters are badly mangled

explanation.surface: Deeply upset, two people separate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Terribly' rearranges GRIEVED.
explanation.definitionFit: To separate and go different ways, as paths split.

clue.text: Experts in digitally-recorded evidence

definitions.meaning: a dab hand is an expert
British police slang for fingerprints, marks recorded from the fingers or digits

explanation.surface: Specialists in computer forensic evidence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digitally' suggests computers, but digits are fingers: dabs is British slang for fingerprints.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang both for skilled people (dab hands) and for fingerprints taken by police.

clue.text: A race — or the end of of a race, say

indicators.note: say signals the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.words: the end of of a race
parts.note: the end of a race is its finish

explanation.surface: A race, or its finishing line.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as published repeats 'of', a typo. The answer is used as an adjective for a people.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective for a people of northern Europe, here standing in for a national group.

clue.text: Lot of grease going on bearing

indicators.note: in a down clue, going on puts the first piece on top of the second

parts.note: fat is grease
E, east, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: A lot of grease is applied to a mechanical bearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bearing' looks mechanical but is a compass direction, giving E.
explanation.definitionFit: One's lot in life is one's destiny.

clue.text: Breakfast food firm breaks an embargo

indicators.note: breaks means the firm splits the embargo word open

parts.note: a ban is an embargo
CO is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A cereal company defies a trade ban.
explanation.definitionFit: Cured pork rashers are a classic part of a cooked British breakfast.

clue.text: Dismissing someone and discussing the matter no further

definitions.meaning: dropping a subject and moving on

explanation.surface: Firing an employee and refusing to talk about it.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means releasing a worker, and also abandoning a subject.
